notes: CDER website-review letter (no facility inspection) for a skin-lightening cream marketed with disease-treatment claims; FDA lab analysis confirmed the product contains high levels of mercury, which is also not disclosed on the label, supporting both unapproved-new-drug and misbranding charges. location_contains is null (website review only, no facility inspected). contamination_present is marked true because the letter states FDA lab-confirmed mercury contamination of the product itself (a judgment call, since this is a toxic-ingredient/adulterant finding rather than a microbial-manufacturing contamination finding).
